title: BioIVT: lab units become a type-ahead UCUM lookup
description: Turns the free-text lab unit questions on Oncology and Test Results into a type-ahead lookup over common UCUM unit codes (curated list of 67).
rationale: Option C: units coded, so values and units can be analysed together.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
